# Driving (UK) — Wyatt's Notes

> Free, open-access study notes. Part of the Wyatt's Notes network at https://wyattsnotes.wyattau.com

Complete UK driving test preparation covering theory test, hazard perception, and practical driving test.

All pages are open-access, ad-free, and licensed under AGPLv3.

## Highway-Code

- [UK Highway Code: Road Signs](https://driving-uk.wyattau.com/highway-code/road-signs/): Complete guide to UK road signs including regulatory, warning, and information signs with the Highway Code classifications.
- [UK Highway Code: Rules of the Road](https://driving-uk.wyattau.com/highway-code/rules-of-the-road/): Complete guide to UK rules of the road including speed limits, junctions, roundabouts, and pedestrian crossings.
- [UK Motorway Driving Guide](https://driving-uk.wyattau.com/highway-code/motorway-driving/): Complete guide to UK motorway driving including joining, exiting, lane discipline, and smart motorways.

## Theory-Test

- [Hazard Perception | driving-uk](https://driving-uk.wyattau.com/theory-test/hazard-perception/): The hazard perception test shows 14 video clips of everyday driving scenes. You need to score 44 out of 75 (59%) to pass.
- [Multiple Choice Questions | driving-uk](https://driving-uk.wyattau.com/theory-test/multiple-choice/): Multiple Choice Questions - Complete study guide and practice questions
- [Road Rules | driving-uk](https://driving-uk.wyattau.com/theory-test/road-rules/): Road Rules - Complete study guide and practice questions
- [Theory Test | driving-uk](https://driving-uk.wyattau.com/theory-test/): This section covers theory test concepts, definitions, and applications with worked examples and practice problems.
- [Traffic Signs](https://driving-uk.wyattau.com/theory-test/traffic-signs/): Traffic Signs - Complete study guide and practice questions
